data.comment:
# Comfy Grok- Video generation

Input text prompts or an initial image frame to generate up to 15-second videos with synchronized audio using the Grok model. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_grok_video.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Cinematic dolly in on a white sci-fi mech suit against a dark background. The detailed helmet armor mechanically unfolds and retracts, revealing a human face inside. High resolution, intricate mechanical movements, photorealistic.
